name: Joahaneun Neoege.
source: One day, when you arrive at school, you find a mysterious letter on your desk. You don't know who wrote it or sent it... You decide to search for the owner of this letter with your friends Oa, Miji, and Jia. Who could the owner of the letter be?
translation: 有一天，当你到达学校时，你发现桌子上有一封神秘的信。你不知道这封信是谁写的或寄给你的……你决定和你的朋友Oa、Miji和Jia一起寻找这封信的主人。这封信的主人可能是谁？
